ref: ADR-0004 Consequences: "An absent parent gives zero contexts, not one empty context" (assumed); #2 §4 mapWithDefault replaces empty contexts [SAP✓ STD], and a queue with no context has none; observation #61
note: To observe in PO, with fn/mapWithDefault/004: mapWithDefault over no context. <Orders/> has no Line, so Sku in its default context Line has no context at all, and mapWithDefault keeps it so: the root's one slot reads a context the queue lacks and the root is written empty. Filling a queue without contexts with one D would give All D.
